facts.fact: 1700 夏：流浪的两人（她与 Piceus）所过城镇只剩灰与骨——「becoming creatures of whispered legends」；离开 Norfolk 远去 Cornwall
facts.anchor: We are a desolation to the world.

facts.fact: 死亡之美的自我认证：「Not the gentle beauty of the ladies...but the everlasting beauty of death, an unending thing, a carved icon from an unknown belief」；饥饿越来越大「needs more and more to quieten」——虚弱到爬不出土、Piceus 不来
庄园赠予：干涸护城河、乌鸦、彩玻——「And he tells me it is mine.」；随即弃置：「You have sated me quite nicely, and I thank you for that.」——用完即弃
facts.anchor: It is a palace fit for a lady, for a queen. And he tells me it is mine.

facts.fact: 追逐中被宣判怀孕：「You are more than hunger now. I taste it in your blood, in your marrow...A foul seed has taken root in your womb. Bear it well, and bear it alone.」——「I am death!」「Not you.」
facts.anchor: A foul seed has taken root in your womb.

facts.fact: 她求取出恶种「I do not want it! Tear it from me if you must, but do not forsake me.」——「If you wish it so, then follow me, Sylvatica!」
桥上：指尖将触即死——心停、七窍黑血「If it is not death, then I wish it were.」——「You cannot follow me, Sylvatica. I will not allow it. The waters will not.」（水阻=母亲同款）
facts.anchor: my fingers brush his on the bridge, and then I am dying.

facts.fact: 抛弃完成：「But I am sated.」——「You will not be alone, Sylvatica. I will not leave you alone.」——留下的是肚子里的东西；「It rips me open, and I let it.」
